strongest_angle: Analyzing Prince Harry and Sir Elton John's Court of Appeal challenge against Associated Newspapers Limited after an 11-week London trial resulted in a High Court dismissal and an order to pay up to £34.5 million in joint legal costs.

key_facts.fact: Prince Harry, Sir Elton John, and actress Elizabeth Hurley are among six public figures facing joint legal costs of up to £34.5 million following a High Court privacy ruling in favor of Associated Newspapers Limited.
The unlawful information gathering trial took place over 11 weeks in London before judge Mr Justice Nicklin dismissed all claims against the Daily Mail publisher.
Following the High Court dismissal of the lawsuit in July 2026, Prince Harry and five other claimants submitted applications to the Court of Appeal in November 2026.
The group of six claimants filing Court of Appeal applications is challenging both the primary claim dismissal and an indemnity costs order.
